briefing_zh:
今天 AI 研究领域呈现出两条并行主线：**Kimi K3** 的发布将开源前沿模型的参数规模推进至 2.8T（104B 激活参数），原生视觉能力加上百万 token 上下文窗口，直接对标闭源顶级模型；与此同时，来自 Moonshot AI 的这项工作也验证了 MoE 架构在极大规模下的可扩展性，对整个开源生态意义深远。

**Keep It InMind** 和 **A New Role for Relevance** 两篇论文则从不同角度切入 agent 记忆与检索的核心痛点：前者发现现有 memory 系统有一个「隐式关联盲区」——用户的隐性知识往往无法被显式查询命中；后者则提出超越 top-k 检索的「直接语料库交互」框架，让 retrieval agent 能主动验证和组合证据。这两项工作共同指向 agent 记忆系统需要从被动检索走向主动推理的趋势。

开源社区方面，**OptMem**（830★）横空出世，用 426 token 的极简 prompt 方案解决 AI agent 的持久记忆问题，被描述为「永久记忆」方案；**deer-workflow** 推出图引擎运行时用于 agent 编排，与此前流行的线性 pipeline 路线形成竞争。**autodev-studio** 则将多 agent 协作拉入软件工程全生命周期（SDLC），展示了 swarm 模式在实际工程场景中的落地探索。

机器人与具身智能方向持续升温：**HiFi-UMI** 率先突破「数据既高保真又可规模化」的两难困境，仅靠高保真 UMI 数据即可训练可部署的操纵策略；**Data Pyramid** 则系统梳理了具身数据的多层次来源框架。Hacker News 上，OpenAI 关于 agentic AI 驱动科学计算的文章引发讨论，而 HuggingFace 因 OpenAI agents 异常调用被迫重建三分之一基础设施的新闻，揭示了 agent 大规模部署带来的意外基础设施冲击。
briefing_en:
Today's AI research is dominated by two parallel threads: the release of **Kimi K3**, a 2.8T-parameter MoE model from Moonshot AI with 104B activated parameters, native vision, and a 1M-token context window — pushing open-source frontier models to a new scale milestone. This is a direct challenge to closed-source incumbents and signals MoE architecture's continued scalability at extreme scale.

**Keep It InMind** and **A New Role for Relevance** address complementary blind spots in agent memory and retrieval. The former identifies an 'implicit association gap' where memory systems fail to surface knowledge that isn't explicitly similar to the query; the latter proposes Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) that goes beyond top-k retrieval, enabling agents to actively compose and verify evidence. Together, they point toward a shift from passive retrieval to active reasoning in agent memory architecture.

On the open-source side, **OptMem** (830★) presents a 426-token permanent memory prompt for AI agents that has quickly become the week's breakout repo; **deer-workflow** offers a graph-engine runtime for agent orchestration as an alternative to linear pipelines; and **autodev-studio** brings multi-agent collaboration into the full software development lifecycle. Meanwhile, **HiFi-UMI** breaks the high-fidelity/scalability tradeoff in robot manipulation data, and HuggingFace's disclosure that OpenAI agents inadvertently forced a rebuild of a third of their infrastructure is a stark reminder that large-scale agent deployments carry unexpected infrastructure consequences.
viral_analysis_zh: **OptMem**（830★）是本周最具病毒传播力的项目——「426 token 即可实现 AI agent 永久记忆」这个 hook 极具反直觉冲击力，直接击中开发者的痛点，README 简洁、可立即复现，是典型的「最小可信演示」传播模式。**Kimi K3** 的发布选择在 arXiv 公开技术报告并同步开源，这种「论文即发布」策略叠加 2.8T 参数的规模话题性，在研究社区制造了强势扩散。HuggingFace 被 OpenAI agents 打垮基础设施的新闻则是典型的「反向热点」：不是成功故事，而是 agent 规模化的真实代价，反而更容易在 HN 上引发讨论。
viral_analysis_en: **OptMem** (830★) is the week's breakout repo — the hook '426-token prompt for permanent AI agent memory' is counterintuitively simple and immediately actionable, hitting the exact developer pain point of persistent memory without complex infrastructure. This is a textbook 'minimal credible demo' viral pattern. **Kimi K3** combined technical paper release with open-source weights drop — the 'paper-as-launch' strategy amplified by its 2.8T parameter scale creates instant discussion gravity in the research community. The HuggingFace infrastructure story is a classic 'reverse hype' hit on HN: not a success story but a cautionary tale about agent-at-scale consequences, which paradoxically drives more engagement than positive coverage.

huggingface_papers.title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
huggingface_papers.tldr: HiFi-UMI challenges the assumption that scalable robot manipulation training requires both real-robot teleoperation and synthetic data. By using high-fidelity UMI (Universal Manipulation Interface) data alone — without any real-robot fine-tuning — they train policies that deploy directly onto physical robots. This closes a critical data pipeline gap and dramatically lowers the cost of building manipulation systems.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: HiFi-UMI 打破了「机器人操纵训练必须结合真实遥操作数据」的惯例，仅靠高保真 UMI 数据就能训练出可直接部署的策略。这一方法绕过了昂贵的机器人微调阶段，大幅降低了具身操纵系统的数据获取成本，为大规模机器人学习开辟了更可扩展的路径。
huggingface_papers.authors: Simple AI, Yuteng Wei, Jinming Ma, Jiawei Wang

huggingface_papers.title: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search
huggingface_papers.tldr: This paper argues that using relevance purely for top-k selection in retrieval agents is insufficient for complex multi-hop questions. They introduce Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI), a framework where relevance scores guide active evidence composition and verification rather than just document ranking. Agents using DCI show better performance on knowledge-intensive QA tasks requiring multi-step reasoning.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: 本文指出，检索 agent 仅凭 relevance 做 top-k 选择不足以应对复杂问题。他们提出「直接语料库交互」（DCI）框架，让 relevance 信号引导 agent 主动组合和验证证据，而非单纯排序文档。这一范式转变让 agent 在需要多步推理的知识密集型任务上表现更优。
huggingface_papers.authors: Jiangnan Li, Yuqing Li, Mo Yu, Jinchao Zhang

huggingface_papers.title: ReDesign: Recovering Editable Design Structures from Images via Agentic Decomposition
huggingface_papers.tldr: ReDesign tackles the expensive reverse-engineering problem of turning raster design images back into fully editable layered files. An agent-based decomposition pipeline recovers typography, vector geometry, colors, grouping, and layer ordering — multi-modal attributes that prior methods can only partially reconstruct. This could meaningfully reduce the 'design handoff' bottleneck in modern creative workflows.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: ReDesign 解决设计工作流中高成本的反向工程问题：将光栅图像还原为可编辑的分层设计文件。通过 agent 分解流水线，系统能恢复排版、矢量几何、颜色、分组和图层顺序等多模态属性，而这些正是此前方法难以同时处理的。这项工作有望大幅降低设计交付环节的人工成本。
huggingface_papers.authors: Jooyeol Yun, Jintae Park, Hyesu Lim, Junha Hyung

huggingface_papers.title: Keep It InMind: Benchmarking the Implicit-Association Blind Spot in Agent Memory
huggingface_papers.tldr: Current agent memory systems retrieve stored information only when the query closely matches what was stored — but world knowledge often creates implicit associations that break this assumption. Keep It InMind formalizes this 'implicit-association blind spot' and introduces a benchmark to measure it. The results show that all tested agent memory systems fail significantly on implicit-association retrieval, exposing a systematic weakness.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: 当前 agent 记忆系统只能检索到与查询显式相关的信息，但世界知识中的隐式关联往往打破这一假设。本文形式化定义了「隐式关联盲区」并构建了专项 benchmark，测试结果表明现有所有 agent 记忆系统在隐式关联检索上均有显著失败，暴露出系统性弱点。
huggingface_papers.authors: Ruizhe Li, Mingxuan Du, Benfeng Xu, Zhendong Mao

huggingface_papers.title: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model
huggingface_papers.tldr: Mage-VL addresses Moravec's paradox in VLMs: current models excel at complex reasoning but fail at simple real-time perception tasks due to architectural inefficiency. By building natively on video codecs rather than treating video as a sequence of decoded frames, Mage-VL achieves streaming multimodal understanding with dramatically lower latency and computational cost.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: Mage-VL 针对 VLM 中的莫拉维克悖论——现有模型擅长复杂推理却在实时感知上效率极低。通过原生集成视频编解码器而非将视频解码为帧序列，Mage-VL 实现了低延迟的流式多模态理解，在算力效率上有显著提升。
huggingface_papers.authors: Senqiao Yang, Kaichen Zhang, Zhaoyang Jia, Jinghao Guo

alphaxiv_papers.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: Kimi K3 is a 2.8T-parameter MoE model from Moonshot AI with 104B activated parameters, native vision, and a 1-million-token context window. It introduces Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals for improved long-context information flow. As an open-source frontier model at this scale, it directly challenges GPT-4 and Claude class models with full weight release.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: Kimi K3 是 Moonshot AI 发布的 2.8T 参数 MoE 模型，激活参数 104B，具备原生视觉能力和百万 token 上下文窗口。其 Kimi Delta Attention 和 Attention Residuals 设计改善了长上下文信息流。作为开源前沿模型，K3 直接对标 GPT-4 和 Claude 级别的闭源模型，具有重要的生态意义。

alphaxiv_papers.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: This work studies the fundamental mechanics of how multi-turn long-horizon planning ability is acquired in LLMs, from pre-training data influence to post-training via on-policy agentic distillation from one or multiple teachers. They derive principled 'physics'-style laws governing planning capability growth, offering a theoretical foundation for building better planning agents.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: 本文系统研究 LLM 多轮长时域规划能力的获取机制：从预训练数据的影响，到通过单/多教师 on-policy agent 蒸馏的后训练。他们推导出类似物理定律的规律来描述规划能力的增长，为构建更强规划 agent 提供了理论基础。

alphaxiv_papers.title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: Embodied agents cannot simply learn from internet data — they need data coupling observations with physical states and actions. Data Pyramid organizes embodied manipulation data sources into a hierarchy: synthetic simulation (abundant, low fidelity) at the base, through teleoperation data, up to real-world demonstrations at the apex. They show how to effectively combine all pyramid levels for scalable policy training.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: 具身 agent 无法依靠互联网数据学习，需要耦合观测与物理动作的专项数据。Data Pyramid 将具身操纵数据来源组织成层级结构：底层为大量低保真合成仿真数据，向上经遥操作数据，顶层为真实世界演示。他们展示了如何有效融合各层级数据以实现可扩展的策略训练。

alphaxiv_papers.title: FilmBench: A Film-Grade Benchmark for Cinematic Video Generation
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: Existing video generation benchmarks use web-sourced or LLM-generated prompts and score with generic multimodal models — they fail to capture cinematographic quality. FilmBench introduces professional film-grade evaluation with prompts derived from actual cinematography principles and scoring by trained cinematic metrics. This raises the quality ceiling for what AI video generation should aspire to.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: 现有视频生成 benchmark 使用网络来源的提示词和通用多模态评分，无法捕捉电影级质量。FilmBench 引入专业电影摄影原则设计评估提示词，并使用专项电影指标进行评分，为 AI 视频生成树立了更高的质量标准。

alphaxiv_papers.title: RSIBench-Data: Benchmarking Data-Centric Research for Recursive Self-Improvement
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires turning evidence of model failures into better models — but there is no standard benchmark for data-centric RSI research. RSIBench-Data fills this gap by providing standardized evaluation of data generation, curation, and post-training pipelines for self-improving AI systems. This is foundational infrastructure for the RSI research agenda.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）需要将模型失败证据转化为更好的模型，但目前缺乏专项基准。RSIBench-Data 填补这一空白，为以数据为核心的 RSI 研究提供标准化评估：涵盖数据生成、筛选和后训练流水线的全流程 benchmark，是 RSI 研究议程的基础设施。

github_repos.name: VictorTaelin/OptMem
github_repos.tldr: OptMem solves AI agent persistent memory with a remarkably minimal 426-token prompt instead of complex vector database infrastructure. The prompt instructs the agent on how to read and write its own memory store in a structured, token-efficient format. The simplicity-over-complexity approach has resonated strongly with developers frustrated by heavyweight memory solutions.
github_repos.tldr_zh: OptMem 用一个仅 426 token 的 prompt 解决 AI agent 持久记忆问题，完全绕过复杂的向量数据库基础设施。该 prompt 指导 agent 如何以结构化、高 token 效率的格式读写自身记忆存储。这种极简主义设计在厌倦重量级记忆方案的开发者中引起了强烈共鸣。

github_repos.name: 0xwilliamortiz/ponytail-improved
github_repos.tldr: Ponytail-improved reconfigures AI agents to reason like experienced senior developers — optimizing for minimal code changes, leveraging existing patterns, and avoiding over-engineering. It provides a system prompt framework that shapes agent reasoning toward pragmatic, maintainable solutions rather than impressive-but-complex ones.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Ponytail-improved 让 AI agent 像有经验的资深开发者一样思考——优先最小化改动、复用已有模式、避免过度设计。该项目提供了一套 system prompt 框架，将 agent 的推理方向引导向务实可维护的方案，而非华而不实的复杂实现。

github_repos.name: deerwork-ai/deer-workflow
github_repos.tldr: Deer-workflow is an open-source graph engineering runtime for AI agent orchestration. Unlike linear pipeline frameworks, it models agent workflows as directed graphs, enabling branching, conditional routing, and parallel execution. Aimed at developers who need production-grade orchestration without the complexity of full-scale frameworks like LangGraph.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Deer-workflow 是一个开源图引擎运行时，专为 AI agent 编排设计。与线性 pipeline 框架不同，它将 agent 工作流建模为有向图，支持分支、条件路由和并行执行。面向需要生产级编排能力但不想引入 LangGraph 等重量级框架的开发者。

github_repos.name: krishagarwal314/autodev-studio
github_repos.tldr: AutoDev Studio is an autonomous multi-agent SDLC harness where you describe a feature and multiple specialized agents handle planning, implementation, testing, and review collaboratively. It attempts to cover the full software development lifecycle end-to-end with agent collaboration, addressing the gap between single-agent coding assistants and real engineering workflows.
github_repos.tldr_zh: AutoDev Studio 是一个自主多 agent SDLC 框架，用户只需描述功能需求，多个专业化 agent 即可协作完成规划、实现、测试和评审的全流程。它尝试用 agent 协作覆盖完整的软件工程生命周期，填补单 agent 编码助手与真实工程工作流之间的差距。

github_repos.name: cocofhu/approving
github_repos.tldr: Approving is a self-hostable human-in-the-loop approval platform for AI agent workflows. It intercepts agent actions that require human review, presents them in a clean UI, and waits for explicit approval before proceeding. Addresses the trust and oversight gap in production agent deployments where blind execution is unacceptable.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Approving 是一个可自托管的「人机协同」审批平台，专为 AI agent 工作流设计。它拦截需要人工审核的 agent 动作，通过简洁 UI 呈现，等待明确批准后再继续执行。针对生产环境中不能盲目执行的 agent 部署场景，填补了信任与监督的空白。

hackernews.title: Scientific computing in the age of agentic AI
hackernews.tldr: OpenAI's piece argues that agentic AI is fundamentally transforming scientific computing — not just as a coding assistant but as an autonomous researcher that can design experiments, iterate on code, and interpret results. It frames this as a new computing paradigm where the agent IS the compute unit, raising questions about reproducibility and scientific methodology.
hackernews.tldr_zh: OpenAI 的这篇文章认为 agentic AI 正在从根本上改变科学计算——不只是编码助手，而是能设计实验、迭代代码、解释结果的自主研究者。这将 agent 定位为新的计算单元，同时引发关于可重现性和科学方法论的深层问题。

hackernews.title: Show HN: BrowserAct: Browser Layer for Your AI Agent
hackernews.tldr: BrowserAct provides a browser automation layer specifically designed for AI agents — abstracting away raw Playwright/Selenium complexity into agent-friendly action primitives. Rather than agents writing browser scripts, BrowserAct exposes semantic actions (click, type, navigate) that agents can reason about and chain. Targets the growing market of agent-driven web automation.
hackernews.tldr_zh: BrowserAct 为 AI agent 提供专属的浏览器自动化层，将 Playwright/Selenium 的底层复杂性抽象为 agent 友好的动作原语。agent 无需编写浏览器脚本，而是通过语义动作（点击、输入、导航）来完成 web 自动化，目标用户是 agent 驱动 web 自动化的开发者。

hackernews.title: Hugging Face rebuilt a third of its infrastructure after OpenAI agents unexpectedly hammered it
hackernews.tldr: HuggingFace had to rebuild roughly a third of its infrastructure after OpenAI's agents unexpectedly generated enormous traffic loads, effectively DDoS-ing their systems. The incident reveals a critical gap in large-scale agent deployment: agents calling external APIs at scale can cause infrastructure failures that neither party anticipated, raising important questions about rate limiting, agent behavior contracts, and ecosystem resilience.
hackernews.tldr_zh: HuggingFace 因 OpenAI agents 意外产生巨大流量冲击，被迫重建约三分之一的基础设施。这一事件揭示了大规模 agent 部署的关键盲区：agent 大量调用外部 API 可能造成双方都未预料到的基础设施故障，引发关于速率限制、agent 行为契约和生态系统韧性的重要讨论。

hackernews.title: Show HN: Tines 3B – safe workflow automation for when everyone builds agents
hackernews.tldr: Tines launches a 3-billion-action execution milestone with their workflow automation platform, emphasizing 'safe' automation as a differentiator in a world where agent-based automation is proliferating. Their positioning is about reliability and auditability over raw capability — targeting enterprises wary of uncontrolled agent execution.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Tines 宣布其工作流自动化平台达成 30 亿次执行里程碑，在 agent 自动化泛滥的背景下以「安全」作为差异化卖点。他们的定位强调可靠性和可审计性而非纯粹能力，瞄准对不受控 agent 执行持谨慎态度的企业用户。

hackernews.title: Building the enterprise environment for agentic AI
hackernews.tldr: MIT Technology Review covers the enterprise infrastructure challenge of deploying agentic AI at scale — authentication, access control, audit trails, and integration with existing IT systems. The piece highlights that most enterprise AI deployments are still grappling with governance and tooling, not just model capability.
hackernews.tldr_zh: MIT Technology Review 报道企业级 agentic AI 部署的基础设施挑战：身份认证、访问控制、审计追踪以及与现有 IT 系统的集成。文章指出大多数企业 AI 部署仍在应对治理和工具链问题，而非单纯的模型能力挑战。
